_notes.copy-to: verso-server.config.json (gitignored) to run for real; this example is safe defaults only.
_notes.mode: 'local' binds loopback (127.0.0.1) and keeps auth dormant; 'server' binds host and turns the auth hooks live (identity phase).
_notes.secrets: Auth client-ids/secrets and TLS material go HERE (in the gitignored real config), never in source code.
_notes.invariant: This backend does storage/transport/auth/presence only -- it NEVER renders. render() stays client-side in both modes.
